name: basal-omni-1.0-ultra

lineage.family: basal-omni (pico, mini, max, ultra) and basal-2.0 (mini, 4.5B, max)
lineage.how_derived: typed-decision fine-tune; Polish and English; experimental, text decisions only, images answered zero-shot

purpose: Decision model inspired by Jev: reads a state and answers typed questions (choice, yes/no, score, multi, act, tool) with a calibrated probability per option in one forward pass, without generating text (card).
